Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.transaction

Class TransactionClosedException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.transaction.TransactionException
dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.transaction.TransactionClosedException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TransactionClosedException extends TransactionException
Signals use of a transaction that has already been committed or rolled back. The closed transaction stays closed; the caller must begin a new one. Carries error code 1101 at ERROR severity.
